race.comment: TOLPUDDLE (5) narrowly missed last time when second over 1600m at Pakenham Synthetic to add to a frustrating sequence of results. This no harder than recent assignments, so just needs a clear crack at them. FOIX (6) caught the eye late last start at Sale when charging into fifth position at just the second run back. Can only be better for that and looks suited up to this trip. RAZANNE (12) missed the placings two runs back then improved last start but found a couple better over 1717m at Sale, beaten only 1.5 lengths, in the same race that FOIX ran fifth. Right in the mix again. OMAMORI (1) gets a change of rider and has been freshened up since finishing tenth over 2000m at Seymour last start. Last run worth forgiving and can atone.
